scope: Vietnam current 34 administrative units; historical observations retain source geography

canonical_geography.aggregation_rule: Only additive absolute measures may be reaggregated when every source unit and definition is covered. Never aggregate index, rate, share, growth, occupancy or other ratios.

sources.geography_basis: NSO province dimension; historical table geography must be checked against the 34-unit catalogue
limitations: Province and sector tables are separate in the published catalogue; do not imply an industry-by-province cross-tab without a direct table.
Table update date is metadata, not the observation period.

sources.periods_observed: 2012–2024 in the local E07.02 extract; current monthly/quarterly releases are separate
sources.geography_basis: source table geography; preserve legacy province code and name
limitations: The historical extract contains 63-province geography and cannot be relabeled as a 34-province observation after mergers.
IIP/index/growth values are not additive across provinces.

sources.source_name: NSO current monthly and quarterly socio-economic reports
sources.geography_basis: reported current province/municipality names; verify current 34 boundary in each release
limitations: Many releases describe all provinces but publish numeric values only for selected provinces.
A national release is not evidence that every province has a numeric record.

sources.source_name: Foreign Investment Agency / Ministry of Finance FDI reports
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Agency, Ministry of Finance
sources.periods_observed: 2025 full year and 2026 YTD reports; attachment availability varies
sources.geography_basis: FIA reported province table; preserve reported geography and period
limitations: HTML reports commonly publish a top-10 ranking rather than a complete province panel.
Do not treat omitted provinces as zero.
Total FDI is not manufacturing FDI; manufacturing-by-province requires a direct source table.
Flow in period and cumulative registered stock are separate measures.

sources.source_name: Provincial industrial-park management boards, UBND portals and official investment portals
sources.geography_basis: source authority geography; current province boundary must be explicit
limitations: Directories mix industrial parks and industrial clusters and can contain duplicates or stale boundary names.
A national table of communes with an industrial park is not the same as a park count or operating-park count.

sources.geography_basis: mapped entity and source geometry; not an official province statistic
limitations: OSM presence is discovery evidence, not a factory registry or market-size measure.
Do not use OSM counts to fill missing NSO, FDI or KCN values.

coverage_policy.comparison_gate: A field may be used for province comparison only after coverage, common definition, common period and geography alignment are verified.
coverage_policy.manufacturing_by_province: unknown until a direct province-by-industry source is found
